mcqs.question: What was the distinguishing feature of the PLFS 2025 conducted by the National Statistical Office (NSO)?
options: It was the first PLFS with monthly coverage of both rural and urban areas
It was the first PLFS launched in 2017
It was the first PLFS to report only urban unemployment
It was the first PLFS to cover only rural areas
mcqs.explanation: PLFS 2025 was the first edition to provide monthly coverage of both rural and urban areas. The 2017 reference relates to the launch of PLFS, not to its distinguishing feature in 2025.

mcqs.question: According to the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE), how many enterprises were recorded in 2025?
mcqs.explanation: ASUSE recorded 7.92 crore unincorporated sector enterprises in 2025. The figure of 12.81 crore refers to persons employed in the non-agricultural sector, while 74.52 lakh denotes new jobs created.
